I replied to Hollis in their DM: the person to call is **Caspian Halvorsen**. On 14 Oct, Hollis told me in this same DM that Caspian is their go-to escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Nettle rollout.

- **No contact details:** I don't have a phone number or email for Caspian, so I didn't make one up. Hollis will need to get those from their own contacts.
- **Only covers Nettle:** I asked Hollis to come back to me if the problem is about something other than Nettle.
- **Kept private:** My notes also have a different Marrow contact that another member gave me in their own DM. I didn't mention it, because it isn't Hollis's to see.
